title: Auto Shrooms
one_liner: An auto-battler where you grow your own mushroom troop.
homepage_paragraphs: An auto-battler where you grow your own mushroom troop.
Plant spores, nurture strange mutations, and harvest your next recruits.
Train your mushrooms, combine weapon schools, and arrange your squad to face the chlorophyll heathen.
When an Adult falls, replant its spores. The next generation carries its legacy into battle.
Grow. Train. Fight. Replant. Fungus Vult!
status_line: Status: In development · Release date TBA

web_demo.observation: The public page requires a password. Do not render a public play button yet.

meta_description: Grow, train, and mutate a mushroom troop in Auto Shrooms, a single-player auto-battler from Cauldron Games. Replant fallen Adults to build powerful lineages.
